summary: A reply to a complaint in RFC 531 that the UCSB resource evaluators had not read the Resource Notebook before testing services. The author argues there was a misunderstanding about what the evaluators were trying to do and how that differs from the aims of the software repository idea.

eli5.summary: Someone said the testers hadn't read the instructions. The testers write back to say that was a misunderstanding about their job.

questions: who were the ucsb resource evaluators
